title: Add browser notification capability and reminder settings fallback
acceptance_criteria: A reminder settings view can enable/disable reminders and edit the configured reminder time using versioned storage.
Permission request occurs only after an explicit user action and handles granted, denied, default, unsupported, and request-error states.
Unsupported browsers and platforms show a clear English fallback explaining that reminders remain visible in the schedule but browser notifications are unavailable.
No notification permission state or exception is treated as a successful notification capability.
Tests cover capability detection, permission outcomes, persistence, and fallback messaging without invoking a real browser permission prompt.
validation_commands: npm --prefix web run test -- --run src/notifications.test.ts src/components/ReminderSettings.test.tsx
